The shared model of a model railway layout: operation locations, their tracks and the stretches between them. Used by the planner, the Module Registry, Module Draw and Dispatch. It builds on Tellurian.Trains.Schedules.Model.Geometry, and on nothing outside this repository.

Pure 2D geometry for model railway drawings: points, vectors, angles, poses, transforms, line and arc segments, paths, distances and shape comparison. Millimetres and degrees. No domain knowledge and no dependencies.

Reads Module Draw's drawing files (end profiles; modules, catalogues, halls and hall plans to follow), of any schema version up to the current one, as IImporter<T>s. Holds the migrations. Writing is in Exporters.Drawing.
Writes plans as plan files (JSON): PlanJsonExporter (IExporter<Plan>) and JsonExportService (IExportService to a file).

Writes Module Draw's drawing files (end profiles; modules, catalogues, halls and hall plans to follow) at the current schema version, as IExporter<T>s, counting up the revision when a write is a new revision. Reading is in Importers.Drawing.

Contracts for writing the Tellurian Trains models: IExporter<T> (one format, to a stream), IExportService (a whole plan to a destination), ExportOptions and ExportResult<T>. The counterpart of Importers.Interfaces.
